Hi Sarah — great to chat earlier. Recap + next steps below.

Recap / recommendation:
- Hosted API (with signed BAA): fastest to get started. Good for low-to-moderate PHI volumes; we provide a BAA for customers that meet our risk profile but do NOT support raw customer-managed private networking in hosted mode.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): our recommendation when you need predictability, data isolation, and tighter control over tenant-level access. Dedicated nodes are logically isolated in our infra and we can expose audit logs, usage tracing, and a BAA. Typically lower per-token latency variance vs hosted.
- Private VPC / on-prem: recommended when customers require full network isolation, customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS), or in-country-only deployments. This is our most compliance-forward option but requires longer setup and an enterprise contract.

What we need from you to finalize recommendation:
1) Expected request volume (peak rps and tokens/day).
2) Whether Elara requires customer-managed KMS/HSM.
3) Which audit retention window you require (you mentioned 7 years for some programs).

Attachments I’m sharing now: Redwood_Security_Sheet_v3.pdf (summary), initial BAA draft for Elara (BAA_Draft_Elara.docx). I will follow up with our SOC2 Type II and the formal SOC2 access instructions.

Next steps:
- I’ll drop the SOC2 Type II and a short audit-logs export sample by EOD tomorrow.
- Rishi, can you confirm whether Dedicated can include a dedicated network peering option for Elara so they can pull audit logs into their SIEM?
- Sarah — if you can send the rough peak tokens/day, we’ll recommend Dedicated vs Private and provide a cost range.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Sarah — quick answers inline and attaching SOC2.

- Hosted API + BAA: we offer a BAA for hosted customers in scope, but Hosted does not support customer-managed KMS or private peering. If you require BYOK/KMS control, that pushes you to Private VPC or on-prem.
- Dedicated: supports VPC peering and streaming of audit logs to a customer-owned bucket (we can set up scheduled exports into Elara S3). Default platform retention is 90 days; we will support export/archive workflows for 7+ year retention.
- Private VPC / on-prem: fully supports BYOK/HSM and complete network isolation — longest lead time (~6-12 weeks typical) and requires enterprise contract.

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (redacted), sample_audit_logs_elara_format.csv (log sample).

Proposed next steps:
1) Sign BAA draft and confirm BYOK requirement scope (which datasets/environments).
2) Quick architecture call with Rishi + your infra/security to confirm peering and logs (30 minutes).
3) If BYOK required for production only, we can scope Dedicated for staging + Private for prod as a hybrid approach.

I’m available Wed 10–12 ET or Thu 1–4 ET. What works for you?

Best,
Marissa
